triggerReasons.message: Ambiguity, user impact, behavior change, or multi-deliverable intent makes intent collision diagnostically required.
Bug, regression, security/auth/session, benchmark, or explicit behavior-change work should have red evidence.
Broad or absolute scope wording should have scope clarification before future enforcement.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: Running node packages/main/dist/tasks/command-catalog-smoke.js exits 0; the smoke fails if a retired agent (lattice-review-channel) is accepted by the dispatch agentType schema, or a dispatchable agent is rejected.
acceptanceBindings.note: CHK-001 happy lane proves smoke exits 0 plus forward (dispatchable accepted) and reverse (retired rejected) directions; CHK-002 happy lane proves the validate.commands entry exists on the normal (non-fast) tier.

note: Acceptance binding covering both deliverables, now with verificationIntentRefs bound to the must happy-lane intents.
